painpoints.text: ADR-0015 baseline derivation is ambiguous when the newest run of a workflow is non-terminal: the running loop run 01M59JSC3MKGRCH5PMR53XHADZ pins the loop baseline at version fb1f7f607b87f1d7a46429700779b96154992a343bd3240cd95aa39120df9928 while every terminal loop run executed older versions, so 19 unrevised terminal loop runs stay permanently blocked as stale-evidence until they finish against the new version. Evidence: fabro_run_search workflow=loop vs `.fabro/revisions/` listing. Fix idea: define the baseline as the newest TERMINAL run's version, or let a terminal run count as fresh when its version is the newest version among terminal runs.
